accounts.name: source
docs: The Position's open Advance, when it has one.

accounts.name: request
docs: The Request the Offer had accepted, required exactly when it had one: it is listed again.

instructions.name: claim_spill
docs: Anyone moves up to `max` spill lines into the basket. Source books are remaining accounts.

accounts.name: invite_gate
docs: until the admin first sets it, and no account means the gate is off. When the gate is on the
Invite key must also sign, passed as the first remaining account.

accounts.name: request
docs: The Request the Offer had accepted, required exactly when it had one: it is listed again.

accounts.name: backer_protections
docs: Self-Excluded, anyone may withdraw their unused Offer at once.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool, whose speedup times the yield.

accounts.name: extend_limit
docs: The owner's Extend Limit, created at the default on the first Extend.

accounts.name: extend_limit
docs: The owner's Extend Limit, created at the default on the first Extend.

instructions.name: grow_store
docs: Anyone grows a basket or spill with their own lamports (a gift to its owner).

instructions.name: grow_store_sponsored
docs: The sponsor grows a basket or spill; needs the relayer's signature, within the caps.

instructions.name: init_ckpt_page
docs: Anyone pays for the next page of a class's checkpoint records.

instructions.name: init_ckpt_page_sponsored
docs: The same page, paid by the sponsor; needs the relayer's signature.

accounts.name: relayer
docs: Fronts the rent through the system program, and is made whole from the sponsor at once
(the runtime does not let a program credit a system account and then allocate it).

instructions.name: init_leaderboard
docs: Extends a Config that predates the Leaderboard, creates the pool Account and sets the fee.

instructions.name: init_native_custody
docs: Creates the shared native custody (vault + pool totals). Admin only, once.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool: owned by the sim_lst program and at its `["pool"]` PDA.

instructions.name: init_source_book
docs: Anyone creates the book account of a Source.

instructions.name: init_sponsor
docs: Admin only: creates the sponsor that pays refundable rent for Players.

instructions.name: init_stores
docs: Creates the basket and spill of an Account that already exists. Anyone may pay.

instructions.name: init_treasury
docs: Creates the Treasury (config, Treasury Account, simSOL vault) or changes its fee rates.

instructions.name: init_treasury_stake
docs: Creates the Treasury without a simSOL vault (a deployment without `sim_lst`) or changes
its fee rates.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool, whose rate converts the payout to simSOL.

accounts.name: custody
docs: The shared native custody, whose pool totals give the earned Yield Fee.

instructions.name: instant_redeem_stake
docs: Instant Redeem of won Gemas of a stake Source, paid in the token from the Treasury balance.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool: owned by the sim_lst program and at its `["pool"]` PDA.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Its Yield Fee is fixed on the Position at open.

instructions.name: open_stake_position
docs: Deposits `shares` of the active staking token into the shared vault as a new Position.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Its Yield Fee is fixed on the Position at open.

accounts.name: opener_protections
docs: is on a Break or Self-Excluded, anyone may refund it at once.

instructions.name: retire_native_custody
docs: Returns an old per-Position vault's simSOL to the Position owner and closes vault and custody.

instructions.name: set_entry_sizes
docs: Sets the entry sizes in Gemas (1 to 4, each a multiple of 100). Admin only.

instructions.name: set_invite_gate
docs: Admin only: turns the Invite gate on or off and sets the key that must co-sign
`create_account` while it is on.

instructions.name: set_onchain_price
docs: Admin: where an asset's Advances read their USD price on mainnet (a Pyth push feed).

instructions.name: set_oracle_lock
docs: Locks (mainnet) or unlocks the oracle's test-mode powers. Admin only.

instructions.name: set_sponsor
docs: Admin only: the relayer key, the pause switch and the caps of the sponsor.

instructions.name: set_stake_apy_ceiling
docs: Admin: the ceiling on the annualised growth an Advance is sized on, in basis points.

instructions.name: set_stake_token
docs: Admin: the staking token new SOL Positions open with (creates its custody and vault the
first time). The stake pool account pins the token's Staking Rate source.

instructions.name: set_treasury_company
docs: Sets the company wallet that `withdraw_treasury` pays (admin).

instructions.name: shrink_store
docs: The owner drops free slots; the sponsor is refunded first.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Its Yield Fee sizes the Advance.

instructions.name: take_advance_onchain
docs: `take_advance` priced from the asset's Pyth feed instead of a price the oracle names.

docs: Its Yield Fee sizes the Advance.

docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool, whose speedup times the yield.

docs: The Position's open Advance, when it has one.

instructions.name: take_native_advance_onchain
docs: `take_native_advance` priced from the asset's Pyth feed instead of the keeper's price.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool, whose speedup times the yield.

accounts.name: prev_source
docs: The Position's open Advance, when it has one.

instructions.name: take_stake_advance
docs: An Advance against a stake Position: Pyth price, sized on the pool's recent growth.

accounts.name: prev_source
docs: The Position's open Advance, when it has one.

instructions.name: void_season_rank
docs: Admin only, inside the 48-hour payout window: the rank pays nothing and its share stays in
the pool for the next season.

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury
docs: Withdraws `amount` SOL units of the Treasury balance to the company wallet (admin).

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury_stake
docs: Admin: withdraws Treasury balance, in the token, to the company wallet.

types.name: Account
docs: One Account's identity ledger. Balances mirror the sum of its Holdings, split by whether the
Gemas are own-sourced (Source owned by this Account) or won (any other Source).

fields.name: own_reserved
docs: Reserved for Offers (part of the totals, not free to enter Matches or redeem).

fields.name: gemas
docs: Gemas minted by this Extend.

fields.name: horizon_months
docs: Horizon after the Extend.

types.name: AvatarChoice
docs: Which picture a Player shows. `Default` is the avatar derived from the Account key;
`NameService` is the avatar of the Player's .sol / .eth record (the app falls back to
`Default` when there is none).

types.name: BasketHead
docs: Head of a basket account: the `LineStore` header (`HEADER_LEN` bytes, byte 1 is the bump). The
lines follow in the same account.

fields.name: until
docs: When the Break ends (unix seconds).

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Trusted for now to supply the issuance price and `YieldAccrued`/`PositionLocked` facts.
This is the seam for the LayerZero receiver (messages) and Pyth (price).

fields.name: platform_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Platform Fee.

fields.name: leaderboard_bps
docs: Leaderboard Fee in basis points of the Pot. Appended after `games`: an account created
before it reads the fields as zero (the unused tail of the account is zeroed) and is
extended by `init_leaderboard`.

fields.name: pool_account
docs: The Leaderboard Pool: `TesoroAccount` owned by the `["leaderboard"]` address. Zero until
`init_leaderboard`; the fee is off while it is.

fields.name: leaderboard_since
docs: Unix time `init_leaderboard` first ran: Matches opened before it were not charged the fee, so
readers show the fee only for Matches opened at or after it. Zero until then.

fields.name: entry_sizes
docs: Entry sizes in Gemas, zero-padded. All zero until `set_entry_sizes`: the default 500 /
1,000 / 2,500 apply, so an older Config needs no call. Appended after the Leaderboard
fields: an account created before reads them as zero from its zeroed tail.

fields.name: oracle_locked
docs: Set by the admin on mainnet (`set_oracle_lock`): the oracle key can no longer register
Positions, report their yield or name an Advance's price (test-mode paths), so a stolen
oracle key cannot mint Gemas. Appended last: an older Config reads it as false.

types.name: EntryLimit
docs: The Gemas a Player may enter in one period. Zero is off.

fields.name: gemas
docs: The limit in force, before any due raise (zero = off).

fields.name: pending_gemas
docs: A raise waiting for `pending_at` (zero `pending_at` = none). A pending zero means "off".

fields.name: window_start
docs: When the current period began (zero = no entry counted yet) and the Gemas entered in it.

fields.name: gemas
docs: The limit in force after the change, in Gemas (zero = off).

fields.name: pending_gemas
docs: A raise waiting for `pending_at` (zero = none); a pending zero means the limit is removed.

fields.name: months
docs: The limit in force, before any due raise.

fields.name: pending_months
docs: A raise waiting for `pending_at` (zero = none).

fields.name: window_start
docs: When the current period began (zero = no Extend yet) and the months added in it.

fields.name: months
docs: The limit in force after the change.

fields.name: pending_months
docs: A raise waiting for `pending_at` (zero = none).

types.name: ExtendLimitState
docs: A Player's Extend Limit. Seeds `["extend_limit", account]`; created by the first Extend (at the
default) or by `set_extend_limit`, paid by the owner.

fields.name: account
docs: The `TesoroAccount` this limit belongs to; the default key until first used.

fields.name: game
docs: Identity of the Game (its program id).

fields.name: authority
docs: Only this key may settle the Game's Matches (a PDA of the Game program, or a server key).

fields.name: studio_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Studio Fee.

types.name: Holding
docs: Gemas held by one Account of one Source.

types.name: InstantRedeemed
docs: Won Gemas sold to the Treasury: `payout_units` is paid now (on Solana in the same transaction,
on an EVM chain by the vault's treasury through the bridge), `source_units` is their full value.

types.name: InviteGate
docs: While `required`, `create_account` needs `key` as an extra signer.

types.name: Line
docs: A slice of Gemas of one Source moving into a Pot or a reservation.

fields.name: fees
docs: Fee terms snapshotted when the Match opened.

fields.name: deadline
docs: After this time anyone may refund the Match as abandoned / no-show.

types.name: MatchWon
docs: A Match was won. The Player is the Account that played (a Backer's win is the Player's for
points). Every season standing is the sum of these events, so anyone can recompute it.

fields.name: pool_fee
docs: Gemas this Match paid into the Leaderboard Pool.

fields.name: loser
docs: The Account that played on the losing side (the opponent of `player`); all zeroes if that
seat was empty. Last field, so events from before it was added are the same bytes minus
these 32 and read as having no known opponent (ADR 0012).

types.name: NativeCustody
docs: The one custody of every native Position (ADR 0010): a single simSOL vault holding their
Principal, and the pool totals behind the Treasury's Yield Fee claim. Seeds `["native"]`; the
vault is `["native_vault"]` with this account as authority. Yield is never held here: it is
minted by `sim_lst` at the moment it is paid out.

fields.name: pool
docs: The canonical `sim_lst` Pool (test APY and speedup live there).

fields.name: vault
docs: Token account (PDA) holding the Principal of every Locked native Position.

fields.name: principal
docs: `PoolTotals` (`ledger::yield_math`), updated only on open and unlock.

types.name: NativePayout
docs: simSOL paid to `to` for a native Position.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = redeem (yield minted), 1 = unlock Principal (from the vault), 2 = unlock free yield
(minted).

fields.name: player_share_bps
docs: Player's share of the surplus, basis points. The Backer's max loss is `entry`.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Acceptance deadline for an Open Offer.

fields.name: use_by
docs: Deadline to enter a Match once Accepted.

fields.name: applicants
docs: Request keys of applicants (public Offers).

fields.name: lines
docs: The Backer's reserved Gemas.

types.name: OldAccountRetired
docs: An account of the world before the yield-by-math reset was closed by the admin. `kind`:
0 custody (`amount` = simSOL returned to its owner), 1 Position, 2 Source, 3 Holding
(`amount` = Gemas taken out of the Account), 4 Request, 5 Offer, 6 Treasury.

types.name: OnchainPrice
docs: Where an asset's Advances read their USD price on mainnet (ADR 0011): the Pyth sponsored push
feed account and the feed id it must carry. Admin-set, seeds `["onchain_price", source_asset]`.
While it exists the oracle-supplied price path (`take_advance`) is closed for that asset.

fields.name: asset
docs: The `source_asset` of the Positions it prices (the staking token's mint or EVM key).

fields.name: feed
docs: The `PriceUpdateV2` account the price is read from (owned by the Pyth receiver).

fields.name: feed_id
docs: The Pyth feed id of the asset's underlying coin (SOL/USD, ETH/USD, HYPE/USD).

fields.name: max_age_secs
docs: The oldest price an Advance accepts; the program caps it at `pyth::MAX_ONCHAIN_PRICE_AGE_SECS`.

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: The widest confidence interval an Advance accepts, share of the price in basis points.

types.name: OnchainPriceSet
docs: The admin mapped an asset to the Pyth feed its Advances are priced from.

fields.name: base_rate
docs: Rate at `base_ts`, 1e9 fixed point (SOL per simSOL).

fields.name: speedup
docs: Yield-clock multiplier; 4,380 = 1 month of yield per 10 minutes.

types.name: Position
docs: A staker's locked, yield-bearing stake. `principal` is recorded but no function of this core
ever reads it except to size a new Advance, and none lets it reduce Debt.

fields.name: owner
docs: Account identity that owns the Position.

fields.name: principal
docs: Principal in source-asset base units.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Provider annual rate in basis points, fixed at open.

fields.name: advances
docs: Advances taken so far; also the index of the next Source.

fields.name: open_advance
docs: Index of the open Advance (the Source with Debt), if any.

fields.name: last_seq
docs: Highest cross-chain message sequence applied.

fields.name: cumulative_yield
docs: Last cumulative accrued yield applied, source-asset units.

fields.name: free_yield
docs: Yield accrued while no Advance had Debt to repay; belongs to the owner.

fields.name: opened_at
docs: Unix time the Position opened: Accrued Yield counts from here (ADR 0010). Native Positions
only; zero for Positions whose yield is reported.

fields.name: applied_net
docs: Native Positions: the yield checkpoint. Net Accrued Yield up to here is already settled:
consumed by closed Sources or banked in `free_yield`. The open Advance counts only what
accrues after it.

fields.name: custody_shares
docs: Native Positions: simSOL shares this Position holds in the shared custody vault.

fields.name: yield_fee_bps
docs: Native Positions: the Yield Fee in basis points, fixed at open (like `rate_bps`). A later
change of the Treasury's rate applies only to Positions opened afterwards.

fields.name: stake_rate_open
docs: Staking-token Positions (mainnet, ADR 0011): the pool's Staking Rate when the Position
opened, lamports per pool token at 1e12. Non-zero marks a stake Position; growth since open
is the Staking Rate now over this. Zero for every other Position.

types.name: PositionUnlocked
docs: The seam for the `Unlock` message.

types.name: PriceFeed
docs: SOL/USD price used for issuance (micro-USD per whole SOL). Written by the oracle authority
for devnet; the Pyth seam replaces this account's source, not `take_native_advance`.

types.name: Profile
docs: A Player's chosen display name and picture. Seeds `["profile", account]`; one per Account,
created by the first `set_profile`. Names are not unique and are not verified: a name is a label.

fields.name: account
docs: The `TesoroAccount` this Profile belongs to.

fields.name: name
docs: UTF-8 (ASCII only), zero padded past `name_len`.

fields.name: name_wallet
docs: A Solana wallet that co-signed `set_name_wallet`: its primary .sol name shows for this Player
(the Account's own wallet is a Tesoro-created one with no name). Default key = none.

fields.name: name_evm
docs: An EVM address linked to this Account through the bridge (`link_evm`) and attached by
`set_name_evm`: its primary .eth name shows. All zeros = none.

fields.name: break_until
docs: A Break: no Match entries, Requests, Offers or being backed until this time.

fields.name: self_exclusion_until
docs: A Self-Exclusion: all of a Break, plus no Advances or Extends, until this time.

types.name: ProtectionsState
docs: A Player's Protections. Seeds `["protections", account]`; created by the first
`set_entry_limit` (or any later Protection), paid by the owner. A Player who never set one has no
account, which means no Protection is in force: every Match entry and Backing still passes the
(empty) PDA address, so a direct transaction cannot leave it out.

fields.name: account
docs: The `TesoroAccount` these belong to; the default key until first used.

types.name: Redeemed
docs: The seam for `PayYield`: source-chain units owed to the redeeming Account's address there.

types.name: Request
docs: A Player's listing asking to be backed for a game and entry size. Carries no split.

types.name: ReservedLine
docs: Reservation of a Backer's Gemas for an Offer; `is_own` keeps the own-first classes intact.

types.name: Season
docs: What a finished season pays, fixed when it is recorded.

fields.name: pool_total
docs: Gemas in the pool when the season was recorded; prizes are shares of this.

fields.name: count
docs: Ranked Players (at most `PRIZE_PLACES`).

fields.name: paid_mask
docs: Bit `i` set once rank `i` was paid.

types.name: SeasonState
docs: A finished season: the ranking and prizes recorded by `record_season`, paid by
`pay_season_rank`. Seeds `["season", number as u32 LE]`.

types.name: SeasonWindow
docs: The payout window of a recorded Season (ADR 0012), kept beside the `Season` so that Seasons
recorded before the window existed keep their layout. Created by the same `record_season`.

fields.name: recorded_at
docs: Unix seconds `record_season` ran.

fields.name: voided_mask
docs: Bit `i` set once rank `i` was voided: it pays nothing and its share stays in the pool.

types.name: SeasonWindowState
docs: The payout window of a recorded season (ADR 0012): when it was recorded and which ranks the
admin voided. A separate account so `SeasonState` keeps its layout. Created by
`record_season`; seeds `["season_window", number as u32 LE]`.

fields.name: until
docs: When the Self-Exclusion ends (unix seconds).

types.name: Side
docs: One entrant. `funder == player` unless the entry is backed; then `share_bps` is the Player's
share of the surplus from the accepted Offer.

types.name: Source
docs: The Advance a Gema was issued from.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of the Position at issuance; Gemas of this Source are "own-sourced" for them.

fields.name: unit_num
docs: Source-asset base units per Gema is `unit_num / unit_den`.

fields.name: yield_units
docs: Accrued yield applied to this Source, source-asset units.

fields.name: redeemed_units
docs: Source-asset units already paid out by Redeem.

types.name: SourceAuthority
docs: The signer allowed to report `PositionLocked` / `YieldAccrued` for Positions of one source
chain (the cross-chain bridge PDA). Registered by the admin; seeds `["source_auth", chain_byte]`.

types.name: SourceBookHead
docs: Head of a Source's book account.

fields.name: source
docs: The `SourceState` address this book belongs to.

types.name: SpillHead
docs: Head of a spill account, same format as [`BasketHead`].

types.name: SponsorState
docs: What the program pays for Players and Sources, and the limits on it (spec "Capacity and
sponsored rent"). The account also holds the lamports it pays out: anyone may send SOL to it.

fields.name: relayer
docs: Only this key's signature authorises sponsored growth and sponsored pages.

fields.name: paused
docs: While set, nothing is sponsored (Players pay for themselves).

fields.name: per_account_cap
docs: Most sponsored (refundable) rent one Account's basket and spill may hold together.

fields.name: total_cap
docs: Most sponsored refundable rent outstanding over all Accounts.

fields.name: outstanding
docs: Sponsored refundable rent outstanding now (all baskets and spills).

fields.name: pages_cap
docs: Most the sponsor may spend, over time, on checkpoint pages (never refunded).

types.name: StakeConfig
docs: The staking-token setting for mainnet SOL Positions (ADR 0011): which token new Positions open
with, and the ceiling on the APY an Advance is sized on. Seeds `["stake_config"]`. Test mode
never creates it.

fields.name: active_mint
docs: Mint of the one active token; default = none yet.

fields.name: apy_ceiling_bps
docs: Ceiling on the annualised growth an Advance is sized on, basis points; 0 = not set (no
Advance can be taken).

types.name: StakeCustody
docs: The shared custody of one staking token. Every stake Position of that token holds its
`custody_shares` in `vault`; the totals behind the Treasury's Yield Fee claim change only on
open and unlock (`ledger::stake`). Seeds `["stake_custody", mint]`; the vault is a token account
at `["stake_vault", mint]` with this account as authority.

fields.name: pool
docs: The SPL stake pool account the token's Staking Rate is read from.

fields.name: refilled_shares
docs: Tokens the Treasury bought back by redeeming Gemas (their yield stays in the vault).

fields.name: instant_shares
docs: Tokens paid by Instant Redeem, cumulative.

fields.name: withdrawn_shares
docs: Tokens withdrawn to the company wallet, cumulative.

types.name: StakePayout
docs: Staking tokens paid to `to` for a stake Position or from the Treasury.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = redeem, 1 = unlock Principal, 2 = unlock free yield, 3 = instant redeem, 4 = withdrawal.

fields.name: rate
docs: Staking Rate at open, lamports per token at 1e12.

types.name: StakeTokenSet
docs: The admin chose the staking token new SOL Positions open with.

types.name: StoreKind
docs: Which of an Account's two stores an instruction acts on.

fields.name: authority
docs: Solana wallet that controls the Account.

fields.name: evm_address
docs: The EVM family address of the Account (zero until set).

types.name: Treasury
docs: Tesoro's Treasury (CONTEXT.md): its Yield Fee on Solana-native Positions is computed from the
`NativeCustody` pool totals (ADR 0010) and minted lazily: its balance is the unminted fee
(`earned_fee - fee_minted`) plus the simSOL in `vault`. It pays Solana Instant Redeems and
`withdraw_treasury` from `vault` first, then by minting the shortfall out of the unminted fee, and holds the Gemas it bought in `account`, a
`TesoroAccount` whose authority is this PDA. Seeds `["treasury"]`. Its fee rates apply on every
chain: `yield_fee_bps` sizes every Advance, and EVM vaults take the same fee at the source.

fields.name: yield_fee_bps
docs: Yield Fee, basis points of every yield increment (2,000 at launch).

fields.name: instant_fee_bps
docs: Instant Redeem Fee, basis points of the redeemed Gemas' value (3,500 on devnet; 2,500 on mainnet, ADR 0011).

fields.name: account
docs: The Treasury Account (`["account", treasury]`).

fields.name: vault
docs: simSOL token account (`["treasury_vault"]`), authority = this PDA.

fields.name: fee_minted
docs: SOL units of earned Yield Fee already minted out as simSOL (to a withdrawal or an Instant
Redeem payout). Never above `PoolTotals::earned_fee`; the difference is the unminted fee.

fields.name: instant_units
docs: SOL units paid out by Solana Instant Redeems, cumulative.

fields.name: funded_shares
docs: simSOL shares the admin funded the vault with, cumulative.

fields.name: withdrawn_units
docs: SOL units withdrawn to the company wallet, cumulative.

fields.name: company
docs: The wallet whose simSOL account `withdraw_treasury` pays; unset (default) refuses.

types.name: TreasuryWithdrawn
docs: The admin withdrew `units` SOL (`shares` simSOL, `minted_units` of it freshly minted from the
earned Yield Fee) to the company wallet.

types.name: YieldConfig
docs: The authority allowed to mint simulated yield.
